aoi_polygon_role: the /Intersects() polygon of every query above
note: derived from the live CDSE catalogue as the Intersects() of the committed OSM outline (the record carries no burst id): a mutable external input, so this file is pinned structurally by --check and by the pin block of figs. A-E, never re-derived offline
query: $filter=OData.CSC.Intersects(area=geography'SRID=4326;<the committed AOI ring>) and ContentDate/Start ge <date>T00:00:00.000Z and ContentDate/Start lt <date>T23:59:59.999Z, $top=100 (one query per acquisition date)
